en: The image shows an old postcard depicting a public square with a prominent equestrian statue of a man in historical attire (likely a military uniform) atop a large pedestal. There are several people, including a woman and children, standing near the statue. The background includes trees and a classical European building. The text at the top is in both German and Russian, referring to the monument as that of Peter the Great in Riga.
